title: Build and Test results of a gate row
description: The `buildTest` field of a per-stage `gates/<id>` row for the Build and Test stage, written by gate_bundle.py from the stage's tables. The page (approval-gate.html) shows a results strip, a filterable target matrix and a decision card per Not Met or Unverified target when it is present, and the stage as any other when it is not. Every part is optional; parts the stage's files do not hold are left out.

commands.description: Every `Check | Command | Result` row of the test results.

coverage.description: Line coverage a result names, with the floor when it names one.

targets.description: The Target Verification Matrix, one entry per row, in file order.

evidence.description: The legend of evidence codes: code to what it stands for.

ok.description: False when the result reports a failure, an error or a timeout.

unit.description: The Unit of the `###` heading the table sits under (U1), else the heading.

evidence.description: Evidence codes from the legend, then the test names.

verdict.description: Met, Not Met, Unverified or N/A; anything else is shown as written.
